description: Light, well-drained, low in nitrogen and organic matter; widespread in Tamil Nadu.
Clayey, high water holding, cracks when dry.
management: Avoid working when wet; ensure drainage.

description: Fertile river-deposited soil of the Cauvery delta.
management: Maintain drainage; zinc deficiency is common.

description: Acidic, leached soil in high-rainfall hilly areas.

management: Frequent light irrigation and organic matter.

description: High soluble salts; white crust on surface.
management: Leach salts with good-quality water and improve drainage.

description: High sodium, pH above about 8.5, poor structure.
management: Gypsum application based on soil test, with drainage and organic matter.

description: Below 6.5 is acidic, 6.5–7.5 neutral (ideal for most crops), above 7.5 alkaline.
Take V-shaped slices about 15 cm deep from 8–10 spots, mix, and send about half a kilo to a soil testing laboratory.
management: Avoid bunds, manure heaps and recently fertilized spots.

description: Organic matter improves structure, water holding and nutrient supply.
management: Add FYM, compost, green manure and crop residues; reduce burning.

description: Government soil testing laboratories and mobile labs test samples and issue Soil Health Cards.
